shortDescription: Manage service group configuration in Citrix ADC

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: appflowlog
options.description: Enable logging of AppFlow information for the specified service group.

options.name: autodisabledelay
options.description: The time allowed (in seconds) for a graceful shutdown. During this period, new connections or will continue to be sent to this service for clients who already have a persistent session on the Connections or requests from fresh or new clients who do not yet have a persistence sessions on the will not be sent to the service. Instead, they will be load balanced among other available services. the delay time expires, no new requests or connections will be sent to the service.

options.name: autodisablegraceful
options.description: Indicates graceful shutdown of the service. System will wait for all outstanding connections to this to be closed before disabling the service.

options.name: autoscale
options.description: Auto scale option for a servicegroup.

options.name: bearer_token
options.description: Authentication bearer token. Needed when doing an ADM service proxy call.

options.name: cacheable
options.description: Use the transparent cache redirection virtual server to forward the request to the cache server. Note: Do not set this parameter if you set the Cache Type.

options.name: cachetype
options.description: Cache type supported by the cache server.

options.name: cip
options.description: Insert the Client IP header in requests forwarded to the service.

options.name: cipheader
options.description: Name of the HTTP header whose value must be set to the IP address of the client. Used with the Client parameter. If client IP insertion is enabled, and the client IP header is not specified, the value of IP Header parameter or the value set by the set ns config command is used as client's IP header name. Minimum length =  1

options.name: cka
options.description: Enable client keep-alive for the service group.

options.name: clttimeout
options.description: Time, in seconds, after which to terminate an idle client connection. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(31536000)

options.name: cmp
options.description: Enable compression for the specified service.

options.name: comment
options.description: Any information about the service group.

options.name: customserverid
options.description: The identifier for this IP:Port pair. Used when the persistency type is set to Custom Server ID.

options.name: dbsttl
options.description: Specify the TTL for DNS record for domain based service.The default value of ttl is 0 which indicates use the TTL received in DNS response for monitors.

options.name: delay
options.description: Time, in seconds, allocated for a shutdown of the services in the service group. During this period, requests are sent to the service only for clients who already have persistent sessions on the Requests from new clients are load balanced among other available services. After the delay time no requests are sent to the service, and the service is marked as unavailable (OUT OF SERVICE).

options.name: disabled
options.description: When set to C(true) the server state will be set to C(disabled). When set to C(false) the server state will be set to C(enabled).

options.name: downstateflush
options.description: Flush all active transactions associated with all the services in the service group whose state from UP to DOWN. Do not enable this option for applications that must complete their transactions.

options.name: dup_weight
options.description: weight of the monitor that is bound to servicegroup. Minimum value = C(1)

options.name: graceful
options.description: Wait for all existing connections to the service to terminate before shutting down the service.

options.name: hashid
options.description: The hash identifier for the service. This must be unique for each service. This parameter is used by based load balancing methods. Minimum value = C(1)

options.name: healthmonitor
options.description: Monitor the health of this service.  Available settings function as follows: YES - Send probes to check the health of the service. NO - Do not send probes to check the health of the service. With the NO option, the appliance shows service as UP at all times.

options.name: httpprofilename
options.description: Name of the HTTP profile that contains HTTP configuration settings for the service group. Minimum length =  1 Maximum length =  127

options.name: includemembers
options.description: Display the members of the listed service groups in addition to their settings. Can be specified when service group name is provided in the command. In that case, the details displayed for each service are identical to the details displayed when a service group name is provided, except that bound are not displayed.

options.name: instance_id
options.description: The id of the target Citrix ADC instance when issuing a Nitro request through a Citrix ADM proxy.

options.name: instance_ip
options.description: The target Citrix ADC instance ip address to which all underlying NITRO API calls will be proxied to. It is meaningful only when having set C(mas_proxy_call) to C(true)

options.name: instance_name
options.description: The name of the target Citrix ADC instance when issuing a Nitro request through a Citrix ADM proxy.

options.name: is_cloud
options.description: When performing a Proxy API call with ADM service set this to C(true)

options.name: mas_proxy_call
options.description: If true the underlying NITRO API calls made by the module will be proxied through a Citrix ADM node to the target Citrix ADC instance. When true you must also define the following options: I(nitro_auth_token) When true and adm service is the api proxy the following option must also be defined: I(bearer_token) When true you must define a target ADC by defining any of the following parameters I(instance_ip) I(instance_id) I(instance_name)

options.name: maxbandwidth
options.description: Maximum bandwidth, in Kbps, allocated for all the services in the service group. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(4294967287)

options.name: maxclient
options.description: Maximum number of simultaneous open connections for the service group. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(4294967294)

options.name: maxreq
options.description: Maximum number of requests that can be sent on a persistent connection to the service group. Note: Connection requests beyond this value are rejected. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(65535)

options.name: memberport
options.description: member port.

options.name: monconnectionclose
options.description: Close monitoring connections by sending the service a connection termination message with the bit set.

options.name: monitor_bindings
options.description: A list of monitor to bind to the servicegroup

options.name: monitor_name_svc
options.description: Name of the monitor bound to the service group. Used to assign a weight to the monitor. Minimum length =  1

options.name: monthreshold
options.description: Minimum sum of weights of the monitors that are bound to this service. Used to determine whether to a service as UP or DOWN. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(65535)

options.name: nameserver
options.description: Specify the nameserver to which the query for bound domain needs to be sent. If not specified, use global nameserver.

options.name: netprofile
options.description: Network profile for the service group. Minimum length =  1 Maximum length =  127

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the Citrix ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_timeout
options.description: Time in seconds until a timeout error is thrown when establishing a new session with Citrix ADC

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the Citrix ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the Citrix ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: pathmonitor
options.description: Path monitoring for clustering.

options.name: pathmonitorindv
options.description: Individual Path monitoring decisions.

options.name: port
options.description: Server port number. Range 1 - 65535 * in CLI is represented as 65535 in NITRO API

options.name: riseapbrstatsmsgcode
options.description: The code indicating the rise apbr status.

options.name: rtspsessionidremap
options.description: Enable RTSP session ID mapping for the service group.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If true the module will save the configuration on the Citrix ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the Citrix ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: sc
options.description: State of the SureConnect feature for the service group.

options.name: serverid
options.description: The  identifier for the service. This is used when the persistency type is set to Custom Server ID.

options.name: servername
options.description: Name of the server to which to bind the service group. Minimum length =  1

options.name: servicegroupname
options.description: Name of the service group. Must begin with an ASCII alphabetic or underscore (_) character, and must only ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, hash (#), period (.), space, colon (:), at (@), equals (=), and (-) characters. Can be changed after the name is created. Minimum length =  1

options.name: servicemembers
options.description: A list of dictionaries describing each service member of the service group.

options.name: servicetype
options.description: Protocol used to exchange data with the service.

options.name: sp
options.description: Enable surge protection for the service group.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the Citrix ADC node. When present the resource will be created if needed and configured according to the module's parameters. When absent the resource will be deleted from the Citrix ADC node.

options.name: svrtimeout
options.description: Time, in seconds, after which to terminate an idle server connection. Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(31536000)

options.name: tcpb
options.description: Enable TCP buffering for the service group.

options.name: tcpprofilename
options.description: Name of the TCP profile that contains TCP configuration settings for the service group. Minimum length =  1 Maximum length =  127

options.name: td
options.description: Integer value that uniquely identifies the traffic domain in which you want to configure the entity. you do not specify an ID, the entity becomes part of the default traffic domain, which has an ID of Minimum value = C(0) Maximum value = C(4094)

options.name: useproxyport
options.description: Use the proxy port as the source port when initiating connections with the server. With the NO the client-side connection port is used as the source port for the server-side connection. Note: This parameter is available only when the Use Source IP (USIP) parameter is set to YES.

options.name: usip
options.description: Use client's IP address as the source IP address when initiating connection to the server. With the setting, which is the default, a mapped IP (MIP) address or subnet IP (SNIP) address is used as the IP address to initiate server side connections.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: weight
options.description: Weight to assign to the servers in the service group. Specifies the capacity of the servers relative the other servers in the load balancing configuration. The higher the weight, the higher the of requests sent to the service. Minimum value = C(1) Maximum value = C(100)
